title: Writing tools
auth: Access is no longer available. Sign in and reopen this workspace. No automatic upload or retry will run.
stale: This preview is stale or expired. Nothing was applied. Make a new preview.
locked: This resource is locked or read-only. Create an editable branch to change it.
conflict: The content changed. Nothing was force-applied. Refresh and review before trying again.
limit: This operation exceeds a limit. Split the manuscript or narrow the scope.
invalid: Check the selected resources, fields and file format.
flushRequired: Save the current editor to the server before continuing. A device-only checkpoint is not enough.
failed: The request could not be confirmed. Your inputs are preserved; retry uses the same request identity.
unsaved: Private form changes — the latest edit is not yet backed up on this device.
localDraft: Private draft saved on this device for your account. Not shared or saved to the server.
localCheckpointFailed: Local draft checkpoint failed. Do not leave until you save to the server, retry the checkpoint, or explicitly download and discard this draft.
recoveryHelp: These drafts belong only to your account and this episode. Restore for review against the current shared record, or explicitly discard. Nothing is published automatically.
preserveRecovery: Keep this exact recovery privately for my account during identity change
preservationConfirmed: Preservation confirmed for this exact private checkpoint on this device. It is not shared; later edits require a new decision.
privateConflict: The shared record changed or rejected this save. Your private fields are preserved; Save is blocked until you review and merge against the current shared version.
currentSharedFields: Current shared fields — compare with your private form above
confirmReviewedMerge: I reviewed and merged these fields; use this shared version as the next CAS base
identityDraftDecision: An identity change is waiting. Preserve this exact current draft privately for your account on this device, save it explicitly, or discard it. Any later edit requires a new decision.
preserveIdentity: Keep this exact draft privately on this device for my account
sharedRecord: Shared record — form edits remain private until an explicit server save
newPrivateForm: New private form draft — creating the entry explicitly shares its fields with this production
biblePrivacy: These settings are shared production notes, not private sources or Console Memory. Notes do not automatically enter generation prompts.
subject: Subject
assetIdentity: Name, appearance, images and variants remain owned by the existing production asset. This panel only edits narrative extensions.
productionRelevant: Explicitly include this visible state in production references
orphaned: Scene removed or unresolved — event retained
orphanWarning: Event {{id}} refers to a removed or unresolved scene.
appearanceHelp: Explicit @references and linked shots are not name mentions or screen time. Click a scene or shot count to navigate.
scopeHelp: Only explicitly selected resources are searched. Private sources and branches are yours only. No media, chats or agent traces are searched.
wholeWord: English whole-word matching (not Chinese word segmentation)
replaceHelp: Ordinary replacement protects @asset codes. Immutable versions cannot be replaced. Matches use server identities and code-point ranges; no browser text offsets are applied.
replaceDone: Selected replacements were acknowledged by the server. Unselected content was not requested for replacement.
importHelp: UTF-8 TXT/MD: 2,000,000 bytes. DOCX: 8 MiB compressed. Extracted text: 500,000 Unicode code points. DOCX is text conversion, not full Word fidelity. No remote URLs or images.
privatePreview: Private preview only — nothing has been adopted into the working screenplay.
boundaryHelp: Boundaries refer to original Unicode code points, not browser text offsets. Cover all original text without gaps or overlaps; explicitly exclude unwanted sections. To merge, expand one boundary and remove the other. Preview corrected boundaries before confirming.
importDone: Private import acknowledged. Adopting it into the working screenplay is a separate preview action.
cancelledImport: Import cancelled locally. The unused private preview will expire; no manuscript was changed.
exportPrivacy: Only this manuscript/version and selected range are exported. Private sources, other versions and world entries are excluded unless explicitly selected. Export does not confirm a production baseline or generate media.
exportPrepared: Fixed export prepared. No file has been saved to your device yet.
downloadStarted: Download requested from the browser. Device save completion is not observable here.
printReady: Clean print view ready. Open the browser print dialog to print or save as PDF.
printRequested: Print dialog requested. Printing or saving as PDF is not confirmed.
